where: c2.yer and c2.alt (Derin phase, from minute 6–7 in every version at or above that length); script §3 C2, §1.5; lesson.json blocks[3].clips[1..2]
problem: "Nefesle kalıyorsan…" and "Ellerle kalıyorsan…" are a word-for-word calque of the English "if you're staying with the breath / with your hands". Turkish does not use "X-le kalmak" to mean "keep your attention on X". In "Ellerle kalıyorsan" the bare plural with no possessive makes it worse: a native ear hears something like "if you're remaining with hands". This breaks the owner's "çeviri kokan yapı yok" rule. It is also the wording of the G2-01 safety door (the option to attend to something other than the breath), so the listener must understand it immediately.
fix: c2.yer → "Dikkatin nefesteyse onu en net fark ettiğin yeri bulabilirsin. Burun, göğüs, karın ya da başka bir nokta." c2.alt → "Dikkatin ellerindeyse avuçlarını hissedebilirsin." Each clip changes by about +1 syllable and the "-(y)abil-" count is unchanged. Because c5.genis starts with "Dikkatin…" more than 15 minutes later, the repetition lint is not affected. Re-run timing.py.

where: a.durus (required; heard at about 0:16 in every version, 5 min included); §4.1 table
problem: "Sırtüstü ya da yan, sana en rahat gelen biçimde uzanman yeterli." (1) The coordination mixes unlike elements. "Sırtüstü" is a manner adverb, but "yan" works as an adverb only with "yatmak" ("yan yatmak"); "yan uzanmak" is not idiomatic. (2) The verb has two manner adverbials: the fronted "sırtüstü ya da yan," and "sana en rahat gelen biçimde". That is a redundancy-type anlatım bozukluğu. (3) Because "yan" is followed by a comma pause, TTS can end the phrase on the imperative "yan!" ("burn"). This is the first physical instruction of the lesson, heard by every listener.
fix: "Sırtüstü ya da yan yatman yeterli; hangisi sana daha rahatsa." This is 21 syllables against 22 now, keeps the "-mek yeterli" form required by TR2-03, and has no "-(y)abil-". A second option: "Sırtüstü ya da yan, nasıl rahatsan öyle yatman yeterli." Re-run timing.py.

where: br.orta (every version with C4, from minute 15–16); also quoted in §0 "Ortak çıkış cümlesi" and §1.3
problem: "Zemin hep seni taşıyor." The slot right before the verb is the focus slot in Turkish, so "hep seni" puts contrastive focus on "seni" ("it is always YOU the ground carries"). The neutral, reassuring order puts the adverb before the verb. The script gets this order right elsewhere ("Yine de zemin seni taşıyor.").
fix: "Zemin seni hep taşıyor." This keeps the same 7 syllables, so timing is unchanged. Update §0, §1.3, §1.5 and lesson.json blocks[6].clips[0] to match.

where: c4.pencere (window announcement, from minute 18–20); related: n1.sec, n2.hatirla, c4.yerles, k.anahtar3
problem: "Biraz dinlenme zamanı." (1) The noun "dinlenme" (stress on the last syllable) is a homograph of the negative imperative "DİNlenme" ("don't rest"). At the start of a sentence after "Biraz", "Biraz dinlenme…" can be voiced as "don't rest a bit". §6 relies on listening to catch this. But the owner chose the MCP path (SAHIP_ISTEKLERI, 2026-09-29), which has no alias dictionary and no previous_text, and a Scribe back-transcription cannot catch it because the transcribed text is identical. So the only reliable fix is in the text. (2) Semantically, announcing "time for a little rest" inside a rest lesson implies that what came before was not rest. (3) The "dinlen-" family already appears 11 times in 30 minutes, which dilutes the key sentence "Uyanık bir dinlenme bu."
fix: c4.pencere → "Bir süre sessiz kalacağım. İstediğin an gözlerini açabilirsin. Sonra yine seslenirim." This is 30 syllables against 39 and gives the same announce → door → return order as c5.pencere and c2.x.kendin. Re-run timing.py, because the window's pre-announcement speech share (T3) changes. Optionally, for the intention sentence (n1.sec, n2.hatirla), weigh "Kendime dinlenmek için izin veriyorum.": it removes the noun-versus-imperative risk and the labour-law connotation of "dinlenme izni" (as in a work leave). Keep the current sentence only if the blind panel hears the noun stress correctly with every candidate voice.

where: c4.yerles → c4.x.istemiyor (consecutive, for example 30 min 19:40 → 20:00 and 20 min 13:57 → 14:17)
problem: Two problems: (1) Deixis flips within 20 seconds: "Orada kendine … bulabilirsin." is followed by "Burada kimse senden bir şey istemiyor." The listener cannot tell whether they are "there" or "here". Once the listener is walking the path, the scene should be "burada" or neither. (2) "Dinlenme yeri" is the everyday Turkish term for a roadside rest stop ("dinlenme tesisi / yeri"), which breaks the image.
fix: c4.yerles → "Patikanın kenarında kendine rahat bir köşe bulabilirsin." This is 21 syllables against 19, keeps one "-(y)abil-", avoids the closing verbs "otur" and "uzan" (G2-09), and removes one "dinlen-". Leave c4.x.istemiyor ("Burada…") as is. Update the §1.3 arc text ("dinlenme yeri") and §1.3 H2 note to match.

where: Orman scene: c4.isik → c4.x.gok (consecutive at 30 min, 20:46 → 20:59), followed by c4.x.yaklas
problem: The two consecutive forest texts repeat the same structure: "Işık yaprakların arasından süzülüyor." / "Dalların arasından açık bir gökyüzü görünüyor." Then "Rüzgâr yaprakları…" follows. That is three leaf/branch sentences in a row, two of them built on "…ların arasından". The repetition lint apparently did not catch it in the scene texts.
fix: c4.x.gok orman → "Dalların ötesinde açık bir gökyüzü görünüyor." (same syllable count). Also extend the repetition lint to scene texts, including suffix groups such as "arasından".

where: k.hareket (K, required, every version; also in K.hizli)
problem: "Bir yerin ağrırsa ya da başın dönerse bırak." The bare "bırak" has no object, and in this lesson "bırak-" consistently means "let go / relax" ("Sayıları bırakabilirsin.", "Bu hisleri bırakabilirsin."). A relaxed listener can hear "then let go" instead of "stop the movement". Safety lines must have exactly one reading.
fix: "El ve ayak parmaklarını oynatıp zorlamadan gerinebilirsin. Bir yerin ağrırsa ya da başın dönerse hareketi bırak." This adds 3 syllables. The K pauses are not compressible, so re-run timing.py for the 5-minute slow corner (T6 margin 15.4 seconds).

problem: "Beden dinlenebilir; sen uyanıksın." Said on its own with contrastive "sen", "(Sen) uyanıksın" carries the colloquial meaning "you're a sly / street-smart one" ("çok uyanıksın", "uyanık adam"). "Uyanık kalıyorsun" (key 1) and "Buradasın ve uyanıksın" (the last line) are protected by their context. Key 2 is the most exposed.
fix: Add a blind-panel item: "'sen uyanıksın' kurnazlık anlamı çağrıştırıyor mu?" If it does, use "Beden dinlenirken sen uyanıksın." (11 syllables, so the 16 → 12 → 8 shortening still holds). Note that "dinlenirken" is a state claim, which G2-08 needs to approve. A fallback that avoids the claim: "Beden dinlenebilir; sen buradasın." (12 syllables); it echoes the final line and drops "uyanık".

problem: "O zamana kadar ona tutunman gerekmiyor." "Bir niyete tutunmak" (to cling to it like a rope) is a calque of "hold on to it". The natural Turkish expression is "aklında tutmak".
fix: "Dersin sonunda niyetini hatırlatacağım. O zamana kadar onu aklında tutman gerekmiyor." This adds 2 syllables and no "-(y)abil-".

problem: "küçük bir duraklama": "küçük" describes size. For a short span of time, Turkish uses "kısa" ("kısa bir duraklama / ara"), so "küçük" reads like a translation of "a little pause".
fix: "Nefes verdikten sonra kısa bir duraklama olabilir. Uzatmaya gerek yok." The syllable count is the same, so timing is unaffected.

problem: (1) The door "Gözlerin açık kalsa da olur" means "it's fine if your eyes stay open". For a listener whose eyes are already closed, that is not an exit. The G2-02 door has to offer opening them. (2) The semicolon in "…kalsa da olur; sonra yine seslenirim." joins two unrelated statements, which is wrong per TDK: a semicolon should join related clauses.
fix: "Bu kez sen içinden, kendi hızında ondan bire sayabilirsin; bire varınca tekrar ondan başlarsın. Gözlerini açsan da olur. Sonra yine seslenirim." This keeps 3 sentences (the clip limit) and is 1 syllable shorter; the "-(y)abil-" count is unchanged.

where: Script §1.1 (Yol B paragraph), §2.5 reading, §6 "Yol kararı açık", §7 "Açık kararlar" (outside the Turkish lens, but a factual statement in the text)
problem: The script was written at 05:21, after SAHIP_ISTEKLERI.md recorded the owner's decision at 04:54: MCP only, no API key, v4 or v2, three voice candidates including a newly designed one. The script still says the REST/MCP path decision is open and plans REST phase speeds of 0.90/0.85/0.80. This matters for this lens: without an alias dictionary or previous_text, every homograph risk (dinlenme, alın, karın, yüzün, boyun, yan) must be fixed in the text itself.
fix: Rewrite §6 as "Yol: MCP (sahip kararı, 2026-09-29); hız, seed, previous_text ve alias yok". Mark the REST phase speeds in §1.1 and §5.1 #13 as not applicable. Move homograph mitigation from "alias / previous_text" to text rewrites and multiple takes (generations_count). Remove the path from §7's list of open decisions and add the third voice candidate.

problem: The two instructions pull against each other. "Saydığım her yeri fark edersin." is followed by "Her adı içinden tekrarlaman yeterli; başka bir çabaya gerek yok.", so it is unclear whether noticing is still required. "Saydığım" also clashes with the counting in C2 ("Geriye doğru sayacağım"), where "saymak" means to count.
fix: c1.cerceve → "Adını söylediğim her yeri fark edersin. Seni rahatsız eden bir yer olursa onu atla." c1.tekrar → "Hissetmesen de her adı içinden tekrarlaman yeterli." (17 syllables against 22; this also normalises not feeling anything).

problem: "bir noktaya yumuşakça bakmak" is a calque of "soft gaze". It also contradicts G2-13 and br.orta ("bakışın serbest": the open-eyed gaze is never tied to a point).
fix: "Gözlerini kapatmak ya da açık tutup bakışını serbest bırakmak sana kalmış." This is +3 syllables; re-run timing.py for the 5-minute slow corner.

problem: "İstersen niyetin bundan sonra da seninle olsun." "…seninle olsun" is benediction register that echoes "Güç seninle olsun" and "Allah seninle olsun", so it tips toward cheesy. Pairing "İstersen" with a 3rd-person optative also sounds slightly loose.
fix: "Niyetini bundan sonra da yanında taşımak sana kalmış." This has no "-(y)abil-", so the K-side 60-second limit (k.nefes, k.hareket, k.goz) is not affected. It is 18 syllables against 16.

problem: "kendi olağan ritmini": "olağan" is bookish, and after "kendi" it is redundant.
fix: "Nefesin her zamanki ritmini bulabilir." (14 syllables against 15).

problem: "Yüz ve bedenin önü." At the start of the sentence the bare "Yüz" can be parsed as "hundred" or as the imperative "swim". The scope is also ambiguous: [yüz] ve [bedenin önü] versus [yüz ve beden]in önü. It is also not parallel with "Bedenin arka tarafı."
fix: "Yüzün ve bedenin ön tarafı."

problem: The list is missing "boyun": BOyun (neck) versus boYUN ("your height"). In a list of bare nouns, TTS can pick the wrong stress. The list is also missing "Yüz" (see TR3-17) and "yan," (see TR3-02).
fix: Add to the list: "boyun (organ, vurgu ilk hecede; 'boy-un' değil)", "Yüz (c1.gecis.on)", "yan (a.durus, virgülden önce 'yan!' emri gibi okunmamalı)". Also state that Scribe comparison cannot detect stress-homograph errors, so these items need a human listener.

where: car.sag2 / car.sol2 (c1.s09, c1.l09) and car.sag3 / car.sol3 (c1.s11, c1.l11)
problem: TDK spelling: as far as I recall, TDK Güncel Türkçe Sözlük writes the anatomical term closed, "önkol". The TDK API did not respond from this environment, so this is unverified. It has no TTS effect, but the on-screen text should follow TDK.
fix: After checking the dictionary, write "önkol…". If "üst kol" has no dictionary entry, keep it as it is, since "pazı" would be unclear.

problem: In "Uzaktaki ses bir yaklaşıyor, bir uzaklaşıyor." the stems "uzak… uzaklaş…" chime against each other within one short sentence.
fix: "O ses bir yaklaşıyor, bir uzaklaşıyor." This points back to c4.ses; alternatively use "Gelip giden ses bir yaklaşıyor, bir uzaklaşıyor."

where: k.hareket, k.bekle, k.son (about 100 seconds apart in K)
problem: "başın dönerse" is heard three times in about 100 seconds. The safety content is right, but the repetition sounds mechanical and anxious, not like a master teacher. G2-04 only requires the line in the rise clip (k.son).
fix: k.bekle → "Kalkmadan önce birkaç nefes böyle kal; acelen yok." This keeps the dizziness line in k.son and k.hareket (with TR3-07). Also change §5.2 row 17 to match.

problem: "Birkaç nefes otur": the listener was already told to sit (d.kalk "sonra otur"), so "otur" with a duration is awkward. It is also inconsistent with k.bekle.
fix: "Birkaç nefes böyle kal; başın dönerse biraz daha bekle." This adds 1 syllable, and the 25–29 second window still holds.

problem: Punctuation. (1) "Hoş geldin; bu dakikalar senin.": a greeting is normally closed with a period, not joined with a semicolon. (2) "Hiçbir şeyi değiştirmeden, olup biteni izleyebilirsin.": per TDK, no comma is needed after a converb when there is no ambiguity. The stray comma also adds an unintended TTS pause.
fix: "Hoş geldin. Bu dakikalar senin." · "Hiçbir şeyi değiştirmeden olup biteni izleyebilirsin."

where: extras.quickClosing (K.hizli, script §3 'K.hizli'; lesson.json extras.quickClosing) + PLAN.v2 B.5 'Sarma' row
problem: The 'Kapanışa geç' sequence always starts at k.nefes. If the button is pressed during C4 (imagery, up to ~7 min of the 30-min plan, including the silent window) the listener goes from 'kıyıda/ormanda dinleniyorsun' straight to 'Nefesin kendi olağan ritmini bulabilir…' and then 'Gözlerini … açıp'. The image is never dissolved and there is no return to the ground: no c4.don and no c4.solma, and image:off/layer:imge-off/nature restore never fire. Pressed during C3, 'bütün beden ağır/hafif' is never released (c3.birak). This breaks safety §11.D-2 ('never go to closing in the middle of a hard block or right after it') and the dışa dönüş requirement of §11.B-14 / Howard 2017 (PMID 28300508), which §1.5 of the script itself cites as the reason for the closing. Seeking from inside C3 or C4 into K ('kapanışın başından çalar') has the same gap. timing.py only checks the length and T1 of K.hizli, so this was never tested.
fix: Add a block-conditional prefix to extras.quickClosing, applied also when a seek leaves C3/C4 for K: `prefixByActiveBlock: { C4: [{id:'k.hizli.imge', text:'Görüntü usulca siliniyor. Zemin seni taşıyor.', gapAfter:{min:8,pref:8,max:10}, cue:{visual:'image:off', music:'layer:imge-off', nature:'restore'}}], C3: [{id:'k.hizli.his', text:'Hisler yavaşça çözülüyor. Beden kendi hâlinde.', gapAfter:{min:6,pref:6,max:8}}] }`. Use new clips (1 TTS request per voice), not c4.solma/c3.birak, because those add a 4th '-(y)abil-' inside 60 s together with k.nefes/k.hareket/k.goz (TR2-03). If the button is pressed inside an announced window, first play the return tone and that window's welcome clip (c2.x.donus / c4.donus1 / c5.donus). Add timing.py checks: for every clip position inside C3/C4, the quick-closing sequence contains the matching prefix, T1 still holds, and the length ceiling becomes ≈ 60–110 s. Update PLAN.v2 B.5 ('Kapanışa geç' and 'Sarma') to match.

where: extras.quickClosing.cue; script §3 K.hizli paragraph; §1.1 Kapanış row
problem: The normal closing ramps the voice −3 → 0 dB over the 5–9 s after k.anahtar3 ('basamak yok', S18/L2-02) and plays the return tone 2 s before k.donus. The quick closing has only cue {music: phase:kapanis, visual: dawn}: no return tone and no gain ramp. A listener deep in the Derin phase (voice −3 dB, bed −36 LUFS) therefore hears a 3 dB step up and a new music phase with no orienting signal. This goes against §11.D-7 (no sudden loud onset during deep relaxation) and against the script's own no-step rule.
fix: Set extras.quickClosing.cue = {music:'phase:kapanis; returnTone:-2s', visual:'dawn', voiceGain:'ramp from current phase gain to 0 dB over 4 s, ending at the start of the first spoken clip'}. Also insert a 3 s lead silence before the first clip, so the return tone and ramp come before the words. Add a qa/timing assertion that no voice-gain step greater than 0 dB occurs at the quick-closing entry.

where: C3 · c3.gelmezse (fillRank 316) — plans 5.2 hi 18 dk and 6.6 hi 17 dk
problem: I rebuilt all 156 plans with timing.plan(). In 2 plans, C3 enters (entryRank 315) without c3.gelmezse ('Ağırlığı hissetmesen de olur. Sözcükleri dinlemen yeter.'). There the listener hears bare state assertions ('Kollar ağır… bütün beden ağır.' / '…bütün beden hafif.') with no forgiveness line. §11.B-5 (relaxation is not required) and L2-05 as claimed in §1.5 ('Ağırlığı hissetmeyen dinleyici bağışlanır') are therefore not true in every version.
fix: In ders2_kaynak.py make c3.gelmezse tier 'required' inside C3 (it enters with the block). The other option is to put it in the block-entry group, so C3 can never play without it. Re-run timing.py and add a check: 'c3.a1 in plan ⇒ c3.gelmezse in plan'. Its 20 syllables plus a 3 s gap fit: C3 only enters at ≥17 min, where the stretch f is ≤0.23.

where: C1 · c1.gecis.on (and car.on3 göğüs/karın), long versions
problem: The only skip permission is c1.cerceve at the start of C1. In long versions 'göğüs…' (mandatory c1.f20) and 'karın…' come up to 261 s later (measured, min 40 s), after two full limb lists. §11.B-9 names chest, belly and hips as the sensitive areas. For trauma-sensitive delivery, the skip door should be heard close to them and not only 4+ minutes earlier.
fix: `c1.gecis.on` → "Yüz ve bedenin önü. İstemediğin yeri yine atla." (tag it safety/door; the imperative is justified like c1.cerceve, and it adds no '-(y)abil-'). c1.gecis.on already enters exactly in the versions where the gap is long (12–13 min+). Add a timing.py check: in every plan, a skip-door clip starts ≤120 s before c1.f20/c1.f21. Short versions pass trivially (40 s).

where: A · a.gozler; script §1.5 'Göz kökeni' and §5.2 row 2 (G2-13 claim)
problem: a.gozler says 'Gözlerini kapatmak ya da bir noktaya yumuşakça bakmak sana kalmış.' The only clip that frees the gaze is br.orta ('Gözlerin açıksa bakışın serbest.'), and br.orta plays only in versions of about 15 min or more. In the 5–14 min versions an open-eyed listener is told to hold a fixed point until k.goz. c2.dikkat ('gözlerini açmak da olur') offers opening the eyes but does not release the fixed point (a.gozler → c2.dikkat is 117–445 s). For an eye-origin app this is sustained fixation with reduced blinking. It also makes the documented claim false: 'G2-13: açık gözün bakışı hiçbir yerde bir noktaya bağlı kalmaz'.
fix: `a.gozler` → "Gözlerini kapatmak ya da önüne yumuşakça bakmak sana kalmış." This is 22 syllables (currently 23), keeps 'sana kalmış' and adds no '-(y)abil-'. Update the §1.5 quote and the §5.2 row 2 quote to match; the 5-min slack does not decrease.

where: BR.orta · br.orta (plays right after C3's 'bütün beden ağır/hafif')
problem: The mid-lesson restatement keeps 'gözlerini açmak ya da dersi bitirmek' but drops the 'kıpırdamak' part of the shared opening sentence. In every version ≥17–18 min, br.orta comes straight after the heaviness list, which is the one place where §11.B-4 ('Kıpırdamak istersen kıpırdayabilirsin'; no implied immobility) matters most. The last spoken permission to move is a.izin, about 13–16 min earlier.
fix: `br.orta` → "İstediğin an gözlerini açmak, kıpırdamak ya da dersi bitirmek senin elinde. Gözlerin açıksa bakışın serbest. Zemin hep seni taşıyor." (+4 syllables, 12 words in the first sentence ≤14, no new '-(y)abil-'). Re-run timing.py; the 15-min 5.2 plans are the tightest (T5), so check them.

problem: The on-screen warning 'Bu dersi araç ya da makine kullanmıyorken dinle.' has two weaknesses. (a) It is a positive instruction built on a colloquial '-mıyorken' form, where dossier §8 Karar wants a prohibitive one. (b) It leaves out water/bath (§11.A card: 'suda …'; §11.C: 'suda, küvette'). This lesson is the one most likely to cause drowsiness, since it is done lying down for 20 min by default.
fix: `openingNotice` and `openingScreen[1]` → "Bu dersi yalnızca araç ya da makine kullanmadığın ve suda olmadığın bir sırada dinle." (single reading, standard form, 14 words). Update §0 and §5.2 row 18 quotes.

problem: 'Şimdi niyetini içinden üç kez söylüyorsun.' and 'Başta seçtiğin niyeti içinden üç kez söylüyorsun.' use the presumptive progressive for an action the listener is asked to perform. That makes them embedded directives, not invitations (§11.B-1, §11.B-4). The present tense is fine for describing scenes (C.1), but here it assumes compliance.
fix: `n1.soyle` → "Şimdi niyetini içinden üç kez söylemek yeterli."; `n2.hatirla` → "Başta seçtiğin niyeti içinden üç kez söylemek yeterli. Ya da yine şunu: "Kendime dinlenme izni veriyorum."". Neither adds a '-(y)abil-', so the TR2-03 60-s limit is unaffected. Re-run the E12/lint checks.

where: C5 · c5.x.oldugu (plays only at 6.6 lo 30 dk)
problem: 'Her şey olduğu gibi kalsın.' is a jussive. Lying down in the deepest phase, it can be heard as 'stay still / don't change anything', which rubs against §11.B-4 (movement is always allowed).
fix: `c5.x.oldugu` → "Her şey olduğu gibi kalabilir." Check that the '-(y)abil-' count in that 60-s window is still ≤3. If it is not, use "Hiçbir şeyi düzeltmen gerekmiyor."

where: C5 / c5.basla, c5.sen, c5.genis, c5.x.hepsi, c5.pencere; script §5.1 row 17
problem: E.6 #17 (uniqueness) is marked 'evet', but C5 repeats other lessons' content, which PLAN.v2 line 451 forbids ("sesleri ve düşünceleri açık izleme Ders 5'in, izleyen farkındalık Ders 9'un içeriğidir"). c5.basla "Hiçbir şeyi değiştirmeden, olup biteni izleyebilirsin." is almost the same as Ders 9's key sentence "Değiştirmeden, yalnızca bakabilirsin." (PLAN.v2 line 444). c5.sen "Bütün bunları fark eden sensin." is the sakshi/witness pointer, which is Ders 9's 30-min technique (line 389). c5.genis "Dikkatin tek bir yere odaklanmak zorunda değil. Geniş ve açık kalabilir." is Ders 5's 30-min open monitoring (line 292, 440). c5.x.hepsi brings in "sesler", also Ders 5 territory. The 24–30 min versions therefore preview two later lessons, and the checklist passes a rule that fails. Under E.6's own rule, one 'hayır' forces a rewrite.
fix: Tie C5 to this lesson's own motifs: rest, the ground and the beden/sen key sentence. c5.basla → "Artık yapacak bir şey yok; burada uzanmak yeter." (calls back to a.acilis). c5.sen → "Beden zeminde, sen buradasın." (echoes the key sentence and the closing "Buradasın"). where: ders2.script.md §2.5 line 233 ("Metin bütçesi … bilinçli olarak …") and PLAN.v2.md B.4.1 "Ders 2 notu" (lines 829–833); timing.py has no block speech-share floor
problem: The 30-minute version is 70–77% non-speech: speech share by clip time is 23.0–29.6% and by voiced time alone (syllables ÷ rate) 19.6–24.3%. The lowest 180 s window is 15% (6.6-lo, 8:10). The documents justify this with three reasons, and the third one is false: "derin evredeki 60 sn'lik yoğunluk sınırı (<= 110 hece) daha çok söze izin vermez". Measured on 30 min at 6.6-lo, the all-Derin 60 s windows have a median of 68 syllables and a 90th percentile of 84. Only one spot reaches 106 (7:47, c2.dikkat + c2.yer). The ceiling does not bind anywhere else, so the sparseness is a design choice, not something the ceiling forces. The script also moves C2 (breath guidance), C3 and C4 (imagery) into the 'Derin' 8–20% band. PLAN B.4.1's own table puts "nefes yönergesi, imge" under 'Rehberli çekirdek' at 30–45%, with a computed minimum of about 26%. Measured block shares at 30 min: C2 20/24/26%, C3 20/25/27%, C4 19/23/25% (6.6-lo / 5.6-hi / 5.2-hi). All of them are below that floor. The owner's "kimse sıkılmayacak 30 dakika" is therefore argued on a wrong number.
fix: (1) In both places, replace "ve derin evredeki 60 sn'lik yoğunluk sınırı (<= 110 hece) daha çok söze izin vermez" with "; derin evredeki 60 sn'lik yoğunluk tavanı (<= 110 hece, VARSAYIM) bağlayıcı değildir: 30 dk 6,6 düşükte Derin pencerelerinin medyanı 68, %90'lık dilimi 84 hecedir; 106'ya yalnız C2 başında (7:47) çıkar. Seyreklik bir tasarım seçimidir; C2–C4 PLAN B.4.1'in rehberli çekirdek alt sınırının (%26–30) altındadır (%19–27) ve sahip onayı ister." (2) Add a check to timing.py: in every plan >= 20 min, the block speech share (sum of dur ÷ block span) is >= 0.26 for C2, C3 and C4 (VARSAYIM, PLAN B.4.1). (3) To pass it, add about 120 s of speech at 6.6 (about 800 syllables) as C2–C4 extensions ranked 700–1000, for example a shorter second rotation like the deleted c1.t2, or a second sound or image wave in C4. At 30:00 the content is already saturated (f = 0.00–0.04), so shortening the gaps alone cannot raise the share. If the owner prefers sparseness, list it in §7 as an owner-visible exception with the numbers above.

where: §0 'Zamanlama' row; §1.1 'Ses' column and 'Yol B' paragraph; §2.5 'Okuma'; §6 'Yol kararı açık'; §7 'Açık kararlar'; lesson.json timingModel

where: 33 multi-sentence clips (27 in the Derin phase). Examples: c2.akis, c2.dikkat, br.orta (3 sentences), c2.x.kendin (3), c4.pencere (3), c5.pencere (3), k.bekle, k.son
problem: The model gives Neslihan (lo profile) a sentence-final pause inside a clip of 0.17 s, and MCP has no speed control. So 'Nefes kendiliğinden geliyor. Kendiliğinden gidiyor.' plays in about 3.7 s at 5.6 lo and about 3.2 s at 6.6: a whole in-and-out breath cycle said in one rush, which cancels the line's purpose. br.orta packs three ideas into about 9.6 s. c2.x.kendin gives four instructions in 12 s right before a 50 s silence. k.son runs the dizziness warning straight into 'Buradasın ve uyanıksın.' The 68-year-old with slight hearing loss, at −3 dB in the deep phase, loses the second sentence. The 41-year-old feels hurried exactly where the lesson promises slowness. Under the owner's MCP decision, app-controlled silence is the only lever, and the script does not use it inside clips.
fix:
Keep each multi-sentence clip as ONE TTS request, which preserves prosody (the existing carrier mechanism). Cut it at the sentence boundaries into sub-clips and join them with an app `pairGap` (all VARSAYIM):
- Varış 0.6/0.8/1.0
- Derinleşme 0.8/1.0/1.3
- Derin 1.2/1.6/2.2
- Kapanış 0.8/1.0/1.2
- c2.akis specifically 2.0/2.5/3.0, so 'geliyor' and 'gidiyor' each get breath-length space.
Add a timing.py check: no sentence boundary in the Derin phase may have less than 1.0 s of silence (TTS pause as measured + app gap). Rerun the 78 cases. Expected cost at 5 min: 8 joins × ~0.9 s ≈ 7 s, which fits the 25.5 s slack at 5.6 hi.

problem:
At 5 minutes:
- The longest silence in the whole lesson is 12–15 s.
- The breath section is two clips (2:28–3:00, 32 s).
- The closing starts at 3:20, so the return plus arrival fill about 52% of the time.
- The intention is said 'üç kez' twice within 1:44.
The skeptical 26-year-old concludes 'I was told how to lie down, then how to get up.' The anxious 41-year-old never gets one quiet moment in which to land. The owner explicitly listens to 5-minute versions.

For targets under 8 min (VARSAYIM):
(a) Add short-version clips 'Şimdi niyetini içinden bir kez söylüyorsun.' (replaces n1.soyle) and 'Niyetini içinden bir kez daha söylüyorsun. Ya da yine şunu: "Kendime dinlenme izni veriyorum."' (replaces n2.hatirla), with gaps 6/8/10.
(b) Apply L3-04, which saves about 3 s.
(c) Give the time freed by (a) and (b), plus the 5.6-hi slack, to c2.akis: at T < 6 min, gap 16/18/20, which stays under the 20 s window threshold. Add a timing.py assertion: at 5 min, longest gap ≥ 16 s in every MCP case.
Keep all K safety pauses unchanged.

problem: 'başın dönerse' is said three times in about 68 s (5 min: 3:39, 4:29, 4:47). The lesson's last words are 'başın dönerse yeniden otur. Buradasın ve uyanıksın.', one clip with a 0.17 s join. For the anxious listener this is a repeated danger cue (nocebo). The 26-year-old feels talked down to. The ending lands on a warning. Only two of the three are required: movement (§11.B-17, G2-07) and standing up (§11.A, G2-04).

Split k.son into two clips:

- `k.son`: 'Buradasın ve uyanıksın.' (cue: the chord, then fade:5s)

where: scenePicker.default; c4.yer, c4.ses, c5.dusunce main text
problem: A first-time listener gets 'Ders içinde seçerim' by default. So they hear the either/or template three times: 'Bir kıyı ya da bir orman.', 'Dalgalar ya da rüzgârda hışırdayan yapraklar.', 'Tıpkı dalgaların ya da yaprakların sesi gibi.' Each 'ya da' reopens the choice and pulls them out of the image. Meanwhile the default nature layer plays leaves at −8 dB even if they pictured the shore. The first session is when the skeptic decides whether to come back.

problem: The shortest imagery arc goes: path start → walking → sound → sun → 'Aynı patikadan… geri dönüyorsun'. Only about 45 s after 'yürüyorsun', the listener turns back without having arrived anywhere. The skeptic hears an anticlimax ('why did we turn around?'). The absorbed listener is pulled out of the image before it peaks.

The first C4 enrichment is then the destination, so every arc from about 16 min has one. Alternatively, reword the required c4.gunes to include an arrival: 'Güneşli, açık bir yere varıyorsun. Güneş tenini ısıtıyor.' This works in both scenes. Then rerun timing.py; C4 may enter one minute later.

problem: 'Sözlerin ardından kısa bir sessizlik.' sounds like a script stage direction, '(kısa bir sessizlik)', read aloud by mistake. The skeptic and the owner will take it for a TTS glitch.

problem: 'Biraz dinlenme zamanı.' arrives about 20 minutes into a lesson called Derin Dinlenme. The logic jars: 'weren't we resting already?' It also carries the known stress trap 'DİNlenme', which can sound like 'don't rest', exactly when the listener is drifting.

problem: 'Nefes verdikten sonra küçük bir duraklama olabilir. Uzatmaya gerek yok.' points attention at the empty moment after the out-breath. That is where a breath-anxious listener starts to feel 'I'm not breathing' (§1.5 already cites Ley 1988 on why breath is not a neutral anchor). The 41-year-old with anxiety meets this in the deep phase from about 13 min. This is a design inference, not evidence.
fix: Either drop the clip (optional, rank 285) or reassure that the next breath arrives on its own: 'Nefes verdikten sonra küçük bir duraklama olabilir. Sonra yeni nefes kendi gelir.' Tag the 'kendi' repeat with c2.akis as repeatOk.

problem: The 68-year-old with slight hearing loss finds the problem only mid-lesson, lying down with eyes closed, when 0.3 s single-syllable items ('diz…', 'üç…', 'kaş…') at −3 dB are missed. The toggle sits only on the preparation card. Nobody ticks 'Konuşmayı daha net duymak istiyorum' in advance.

'Hayır' turns speechClarity on and remembers it. If the profile holds an age ≥ 60, pre-select the toggle. (UI; VARSAYIM.)

problem: 'Ağırlığı hissetmesen de olur.' comes before the listener has tried anything. It primes failure for the skeptic. It also stacks a third 'hisset-' right after 'zemini hissedebilirsin'.
fix: Play c3.gelmezse after c3.a3 'bütün beden ağır.' and before c3.zemin. Durations do not change; re-check the repetition lint.

problem: 'Yapman gereken hiçbir şey yok' is followed within 2 minutes by about 10 instructions: lie down, cover, eyes, settle, choose, repeat three times, notice. The skeptic catches the contradiction.
fix: Make the already-written variant 'Bir şey başarman gerekmiyor; yalnızca dinlenmek var.' the primary text and rotate the current line as a variant. c2.kal still works on its own.

problem: 'Saydığım her yeri fark edersin.' is in the aorist, so it reads as a prediction ('you will notice'). A skeptic answers 'and if I don't?'
fix: 'Adını söylediğim her yeri kısaca fark ediyorsun. Seni rahatsız eden bir yer olursa onu atla.' The present narration matches n1.sec/n1.soyle and avoids another '-(y)abil-'.

problem: The line moves from 'Bedenin' (your body) to 'Beden' (the body). To an anxious listener this can sound detaching, the very feeling §1.5 avoids with Khasky & Smith 1999. It also makes the refrain sound like a misread of line 1.
fix: 'Bedenin dinlenebilir; sen uyanıksın.' (13 syllables; the sequence 16 → 13 → 8 still shortens). Update §0, §1.2 and the H3 syllable check.

problem: 'Ardında belli belirsiz izler kalıyor.' points attention behind the listener's back with a vague, half-seen trace. That is slightly eerie for the anxious listener.
fix: Main text: 'Geride kendi ayak izlerin kalıyor.' Kıyı: 'Kumda kendi ayak izlerin kalıyor.' Orman: 'Yumuşak toprakta kendi ayak izlerin kalıyor.'

problem: 'Uzanıyorsan önce bir yanına dön.' Everyone was told to lie down, and a.durus allowed side-lying. The side-lying 68-year-old wonders whether to turn to the other side.
fix: 'Sırtüstü yatıyorsan önce bir yanına dön.' Leave d.kalk as it is: it also covers sitting up.

problem: If production reuses a take, or MCP returns near-identical takes, the left side is an audible copy-paste of the right side about 80 s later. The skeptic hears a machine.
fix: Add a §6 rule: left and right carriers are separate requests, and the chosen left take must not be the same take as the right. With generations_count, prefer a left take whose F0 contour differs.
